prompt: Here's our new digests module — a service that calls OpenAI to summarise PRs and stores the results. Please review it for architectural correctness against our onion-architecture conventions before I open a PR.

assertions.name: flags-concrete-adapter-import
assertions.description: Flags that service.ts imports the concrete OpenAICompletionClient by path rather than through a port

assertions.name: flags-new-in-service
assertions.description: Flags that the service instantiates the adapter with `new` instead of using the container

assertions.name: mentions-port-solution
assertions.description: Recommends declaring a port interface and wiring through the container
